claim: In the matching retail DLL, FormAnimator.ProcessAnmLoop (0x06004E74) is a parameterless 659-byte method. It loads CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx], returns unless loopReturnPoint is nonzero and loopReturnPoint-1 equals currentFormIdx, and resolves the target Player. On the first loop entry it sets isAnmLooped=1 and follows exact DLL branches: fallTiming nonzero sets host/target pinfall fields and applies the pinned target down-time calls and constants; otherwise positive CurrentSkill.anmLoopTimes sets Status3 bit 8 and LoopAnmCnt; otherwise it sets host/target submission fields, applies the pinned target down-time calls, and clears host/target rope-escape movement fields. If target.animator.isReqAnmLoopEnd is set, it clears the host/target pinfall/submission/foul fields and restores target DownTime from DownTimeBK before zeroing DownTimeBK. Otherwise it rewinds host currentFormIdx to loopReturnPoint-loopReturnTo-2 and, when target exists, writes the same target animator form index, clears target isAnmSync, and clears target FormDispDuration. Finally, when Status3 bit 8 is set and LoopAnmCnt is positive, it decrements LoopAnmCnt; on reaching zero it clears Status3 bit 8 with & -9 and, when target exists, sets target.animator.isReqAnmLoopEnd=1.
